q: How many requests per minute is each client allowed before throttling kicks in?

results.text: Rate limiting is 100 requests per minute per client id, enforced at the router layer.
axios is forbidden in this codebase; outbound HTTP goes through the platform fetch wrapper with a 2-attempt retry budget.
Staging runs Postgres 16 after the October migration; the old Postgres 14 cluster is decommissioned.
Authorization is enforced by the policy engine; the identity module (renamed from auth) reads its configuration from identity.yaml.
The gateway's default listen port is 8787.
The production deploy window is Friday afternoons.
